label: Nimish (milk foam)
note: Only made in the cold months: in warmth the foam collapses. It is served at dawn.

about.text: Nimish, also called malaiyo or makhan malai, is a winter sweet of Uttar Pradesh: milk boiled, cooled overnight in the open and whipped at dawn into a light foam that is flavoured with saffron and cardamom and sold in clay cups. The name Makhan malai means cream butter, though it contains neither.
